confirmedIssues: AC-1.1 / TC-1.1a is still unmet in the production PI extension path: `resolveCaptureThread()` only creates a new managed thread on `message_end` (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:611-645`), but the epic and tech design require a thread to exist when capture starts on `session_start` (`docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/epic.md:87-109`, `docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/tech-design.md:664-683`, `docs/spec-build/technical-architecture.md:372`). I reproduced this by emitting `session_start` for a brand-new session and `store.findManagedThread(target)` still returned no thread.

The command-surface test plan is still not fully implemented. `docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/test-plan.md:181-185` expects command coverage for `/lh-attach` success/conflict summaries, `/lh-turn-health`, `/lh-repair-turns`, `/lh-fixture`, and `/lh-status` with thread state, but `tests/context-steward/pi-extension-commands.test.ts:88-345` only covers formatter behavior, fixture flows, two `/lh-attach` happy paths, and `/lh-status` with no managed thread.
disputedOrUnconfirmedIssues: The prior blocker that lifecycle events auto-managed pre-populated sessions before attach/import is no longer supported: `resolveCaptureThread()` now refuses to auto-create on `session_start` and only auto-creates on `message_end` when `canAutoCreateManagedThreadForMessageEnd()` allows it (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:126-159`, `611-645`), and `tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts:764-802` now proves pre-populated sessions remain unmanaged before attach/import.

The prior blocker that `/lh-attach` ignored live branch context or bound imports to the wrong target is no longer supported: `executeAttachCommand()` now forwards `activeLeafId` and the live `sessionManager` (`src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:350-368`), `attachExistingPiSession()` retargets non-context session-file imports (`src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:117-139`, `302-325`), and the command tests cover both the active-branch and explicit-file cases (`tests/context-steward/pi-extension-commands.test.ts:201-323`).

The prior blocker that `verify-all` was hollow is no longer supported: `tests/context-steward/file-thread-store.integration.test.ts` now exists with the planned smoke cases, `scripts/run-node-tests.mjs:41-43` now fails when no integration tests are found, and `npm run verify-all` passed in the current workspace with 107 unit tests plus 4 integration tests.
The synthetic import `sessionManager` shim in `src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:141-159` still exists, but I did not verify a current functional or artifact-level failure from it.
result.readinessAssessment: The original attach/import and integration-gate blockers from the prior review are fixed, and the current `npm run verify-all` gate passes. The epic is still not ready for closeout because the production `session_start` path does not satisfy the source-thread initialization contract for a new managed session, and the documented command-surface coverage plan is still incomplete.
result.recommendedNextStep: Make `session_start` create or open the managed thread for brand-new managed sessions without reintroducing pre-populated-session auto-management, add the missing command-layer tests, then rerun `npm run verify-all`.
